metadata.scope: Collection of qualified and rejected kernel trials, synthetic Gaussian-cache decoding screens, isolated hot-buffer timings, changed-arithmetic regression checks, and retained real-text pilots. This collection creates no new inference samples. Partial/interrupted searches and failures are included and are not claims of passing candidates. The selected program is separately independently qualified and benchmarked on retained C4 token IDs.
notes: decode-grid-v3/results.json legacy granule field records the physical split count; the emitted kernel source fixes actual granule=128 and contains the true splits parameter. Corrected results are separate, preserving raw data.

Rejected streamed and native_f32 prototype helpers were removed from production; frozen helpers are under rejected-source. Other rejected prototypes retain compiled shader artifacts for replay; rebuilding every rejected historical variant from the final source is not claimed.

change.description: Retain context-wide Vulkan optimization evidence; no new performance samples
